business_problem: gain visibility across an outsourced global supply chain so teams could trace components, manage risk, and improve product quality and on-time delivery.
solution_summary: Juniper Networks uses Snowflake on Snowflake to gain visibility across an outsourced global supply chain so teams could trace components, manage risk, and improve product quality and on-time delivery. Internal and external data from manufacturing partners, operations, SAP ERP, Amazon S3, and customer systems are unified in Snowflake to create component-to-customer visibility. Juniper uses the platform as both a data lake and a warehouse, loading high-volume records quickly and connecting previously disconnected supply chain signals in one environment. Applications, compliance, supply chain operations, finance, marketing, and Juniper Support Insights all consume the shared data to improve delivery, prevent outages, and make better customer decisions. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and downstream access on one governed platform reduces data copying, simplifies operations, and gives teams a single trusted operating view for analytics and AI.
